services.name: Ghost Tours
services.desc: Step back in time and uncover 9 explosive riots that shaped Vancouver’s history. Spanning from the turbulent 1880s to the infamous 2011 Stanley Cup riot, this gripping walking tour dives deep into a century of clash and conflict. From labor strikes and racial tensions to sports mania and counterculture clashes, discover the raw, hidden stories of the city-and get to the heart of why Vancouverites have a surprising history of taking it to the streets. Slip into the shadow-soaked streets of Gastown and Chinatown for a gripping 90-minute descent into Vancouver's underworld.
